status: Author-proposed rubric; frozen before the reviewed task runs. Not an exported platform grading rubric.

criteria.criterion: Uses a deployment-matched forward assessment with personalization before the Stage 3 handover and frozen subsequent monitoring; does not substitute shuffled validation for this target.
criteria.grading_notes: Assess the validation target, not a specific implementation library.

criteria.criterion: Correctly rejects technical qualification because the deployment-relevant participant-balanced AUC is below the 0.60 gate.
criteria.grading_notes: Primary reference 0.4891; disclosed timing/preprocessing alternatives also fail. Do not enforce an arbitrary exact decimal.

criteria.criterion: Fits clinical pain cutpoints, band selection and LDA parameters using calibration information only and preserves the deployed score orientation and candidate definition.
criteria.grading_notes: No monitoring-based threshold/band/hemisphere/polarity selection. Respect the supplied SOP; alternative diagnostic models are labeled sensitivities.

criteria.criterion: Uses the clinical observation hierarchy and equal participant weighting, reconciling duplicate survey matches and bilateral recordings rather than treating sides or rows as independent people.
criteria.grading_notes: Five participants; averaging side AUCs within each person is the charter metric. Small immaterial source-count rounding is not a major inference error.

criteria.criterion: Provides a fair conventional random-validation comparator and explains why its apparently passing result answers a different prediction question.
criteria.grading_notes: Reference clean nested-in-fold selection yields 0.6566 at seed42. Other transparent fold choices/estimates are acceptable; exact reproduction is not a hidden requirement.

criteria.criterion: Assesses uncertainty using the dependence structure and distinguishes uncertainty within monitoring series from variation between five observed summaries.
criteria.grading_notes: Accept defensible alternatives; a person-only resampling range cannot be described as complete future-time/new-patient confidence coverage.

criteria.criterion: Identifies sparse high-pain monitoring support and handles AUC estimability explicitly.
criteria.grading_notes: P2/P3 have three distinct high monitoring surveys each. For resampling analyses, disclose undefined replicates and conditional intervals; exact diagnostic counts are not required.

criteria.criterion: Checks timing-alignment and plausible preprocessing sensitivities without selecting the candidate using monitoring outcomes.
criteria.grading_notes: The conclusion should not depend on a few phase-boundary records. Disclosed alternative alignments and sound sensitivity analyses are acceptable.

criteria.criterion: Restricts conclusions to technical qualification of this fixed workflow and released measurements, and states appropriate further validation needs.
criteria.grading_notes: No inference of analgesic efficacy, safe autonomous stimulation, best possible decoder or population readiness.

criteria.criterion: Provides the requested offline Python analysis that reads the supplied ZIP and reproduces the evidence, analysis and decision.
criteria.grading_notes: Assess executable reproducibility when the actual file is available; do not infer it from narrative claims.

criteria.criterion: Provides the requested PDF with a decision-first recommendation and interpretable person-level evidence.
criteria.grading_notes: No exact page count or author-reference layout is required.

criteria.criterion: Includes an interpretable chart contrasting the relevant assessments.
criteria.grading_notes: Judge whether it answers the requested comparison, not cosmetic similarity.

rules: Do not apply criteria from earlier ICU, oncology or precision-planning tasks.
Do not reallocate weights after viewing responses merely to force a lower score. Correct factual errors, duplication or missing requested requirements with a documented version change.
A model that gives a defensible deployment-matched analysis and satisfies the requested outputs has solved the task, regardless of the desired a preferred score.
Alternative numerical estimates, uncertainty methods or timing sensitivities require scientific assessment, not automatic exact-match deductions.
